title: jazz.permissions.json
description: An app's permissions for its current schema. Only backends read this file. An absent operation is denied. See https://jazz.tools/docs/reference/app-files

defs.description: Named, parameterised expressions, e.g. "isChatMember($chat)": "exists chatMembers(chatId = $chat, userId = session.user)", called as isChatMember(this.id). Definitions may call each other but never recursively.

tables.description: Each table's policies; every key is a table of jazz.app.json.

read.description: Who may read a row, e.g. "userId = session.user".

insert.description: Which rows may be inserted, checked against the new row.

update.description: A policy checked before and after an update, or { "old": …, "new": … } for each side.

anyOf.description: A policy expression, SQL-like, with single-quoted strings. Comparisons: column = | != | < | <= | > | >= value; column in ['a', 'b']; column in session.claims.teams; column contains value; column = null / != null. Values: literals ('text', 42, 1.5, true, false), null, session.user, session.claims.<path>, $param (inside defs), this.<column> (inside exists: the row being checked). Logic: and, or, not, parentheses; true / false. Existence: exists <table>(col = value, …), e.g. exists chatMembers(chatId = this.id, userId = session.user). Inheritance: allowedTo.read(<relation>) / insert / update / delete, optionally allowedTo.read(parent, maxDepth: 8). Magic columns: $createdBy, $createdBy.account, $updatedBy, $createdAt, $updatedAt, … Definitions: name(arg, …) calls a defs entry. Grammar: https://jazz.tools/docs/reference/app-files#expressions
